products.name: Portable Ultrasound Pro X1
products.shortDesc: High-resolution ultrasound for portable medical imaging with HD touchscreen
products.fullDesc:
The Portable Ultrasound Pro X1 represents excellence in mobile medical imaging. Equipped with a 15-inch HD touchscreen and interchangeable multi-frequency probes, this device offers exceptional image quality.

Main Features

  • 15-inch touchscreen with 1920x1080 resolution
  • Optimized portability (weight: 3.2 kg)
  • 6-hour battery life with built-in battery
  • Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity for data transfer
